description: Prefer ~/.openagents/bin/llama-server first in LocalModelServer.findLlamaServer() in Window+Dialogs.swift.

steps.send: In `apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift`, update `LocalModelServer.findLlamaServer()` so it checks `~/.openagents/bin/llama-server` (via `FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.appendingPathComponent(".openagents/bin/llama-server").path`) first in `candidates`, before `/opt/homebrew/bin/llama-server`. Verify syntax with `swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift`.
